analogy.rationale: Glucocorticoid receptor antagonists act on a nuclear receptor that many of these cell lines express at low levels, so transcriptional effects should be weak; the closest analogs are other nuclear-receptor ligands, especially glucocorticoid receptor agonists and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, which share receptor-family and downstream transcriptional machinery.
